_comment: What a supporter sees when they tell HO:RA they can't do a task they accepted (cant_do.go).
The app shows this text as sent. Bump version when the wording changes.
reasons[].code is what is recorded and what ops see; never reuse a code for a different meaning. Remove a reason by deleting it; old reports keep their code.
button_caption: Tell HO:RA. We'll get in touch.
heading: Can't do this task?
intro: Tell us what's going on and we'll contact you. Nothing changes on the task until we do.

reasons.label: The task isn't what was described

bought_question: Have you already bought anything for this task?
done_body: HO:RA will contact you shortly. If you feel unsafe, leave now: you don't need to wait for us.
reported_label: You told HO:RA you can't do this task. We'll contact you.
